purpose: Teach: 茎/世俗/パラダイム/フェミニズム/中南米/遠距離/金星/生死

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、植物の茎を凶器にした事件を、警察、扱われますね
lines.en: The police do handle cases where plant stems have been used as weapons, don't they?
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured pace. Leans slightly forward. Genuine curiosity underneath — this is a real question, not rhetorical. Soft attack on the opening word.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、世俗的犯罪と宗教的犯罪を分けて分析されますね
lines.en: The police do analyze secular crimes and religiously-motivated crimes separately, I understand.
lines.style: Calm, professional confirmation. Steady eye contact. A small nod of acknowledgment. Neither patronizing nor distant — meeting his intellectual footing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、捜査のパラダイム転換を、警察、検討されますね
lines.en: This case seems to require a real paradigm shift in how the investigation is approached, wouldn't you say?
lines.style: Tentative but deliberate. The tone of someone testing an idea aloud, wanting to see if it lands. Slight pause before the question tag, checking for permission to continue thinking out loud.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、フェミニズム関連の嫌がらせ事案にも対応されますね
lines.en: The police do respond to harassment cases involving feminist tensions, yes.
lines.style: Direct, matter-of-fact. Professional certainty without coldness. A statement of fact delivered with quiet confidence. Brief, efficient.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、中南米からの密入国を、警察、警戒されますね
lines.en: Are the police concerned about illegal entry attempts from Central and South America in this case?
lines.style: Careful phrasing, deliberate word choice. Slightly lower volume. The tone of someone naming something sensitive but necessary. Looking for validation that this angle matters.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、遠距離での通信傍受技術もお持ちですね
lines.en: The police have long-range communications surveillance capabilities, I gather.
lines.style: Quiet observation. Not accusatory — factual, almost conversational. A gentle acknowledgment of capability. Brief pause at the end, inviting response.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、金星探査機関連の機密漏洩を、警察、扱われますね
lines.en: There's also the matter of classified information leaks related to the Venus mission that the police may need to investigate.
lines.style: Careful, deliberate articulation. The cadence of someone laying out a serious concern methodically. No rush. Slight emphasis on 'classified' — the weight of the matter is in the word choice, not the delivery.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、生死を分ける現場対応もされますね
lines.en: The police face situations where split-second decisions determine life and death on the ground.
lines.style: Quieter now, deeper respect in the tone. This is no longer testing — this is recognition of something difficult and real. Slower pace. A small acknowledgment of the weight he carries.
